stars.why: Austin Reaves (left heel bruise) and Walker Kessler (right lower-leg soreness) are both out tonight, so even more of the Lakers' offense runs through him. With Reaves out Sunday he played 36 minutes and scored 43, and Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder and Kon Knueppel.

Detroit is without its starting center, Jalen Duren (right hamstring strain), plus Duncan Robinson, Taurean Prince and Ronald Holland II, with Isaiah Joe doubtful. He played 35 minutes Sunday, and De'Aaron Fox, who missed that game, is not on San Antonio's injury report tonight.

stars.why: Detroit is down to a thin rotation: Jalen Duren, Duncan Robinson, Taurean Prince and Ronald Holland II are out and Isaiah Joe is doubtful, so the offense leans on him and Daniss Jenkins. He played 36 minutes Saturday; the one risk is San Antonio being an 8.5-point favorite.

He played 43 minutes in Sunday's overtime win in Toronto, scoring 15 of his 28 in the fourth quarter, and this is a rematch in Toronto two nights later. New York has nobody on tonight's injury report, and Toronto has been starting the smaller Collin Murray-Boyles at center over Jakob Poeltl.

Ja Morant (hamstring, out until at least Thanksgiving) and Shaedon Sharpe are still out, so Portland's offense runs through his drives; 22 of Portland's first 41 points Monday came in the paint. He played only 30 minutes because Portland emptied its bench down 19 late, and Portland had not posted its injury report Tuesday morning for this back-to-back rematch.

Jonathan Kuminga also left Monday with a right shoulder injury, and Minnesota had not posted its injury report Tuesday morning.

guide: Pair two or three stars with two or three scrubs, then fill the middle. The scrubs are what make the stars fit under the $50,000 cap.
